title: TicTac4Ever
tagline: TicTac4Ever is a multiplayer TicTacToe that never ends! Users will persue half of the existing prize pot putting piezes in a row. We hate bots so this game has anti-bot measures.
description: TicTac4Ever brings the classic and well-known TicTacToe to web3 in a more user-friendly way. Users compete to get 3 pieces in a row and the one who achieves it wins half of the existing prize, the rest keeps playing. We don't like bots so only unique humans can play it, one human = one player. Forget about gas and pay only with your preferred ERC20 token for each move :)
how_its_made:
We bring a famous multiplayer game, giving it a fresh look with Nouns NFTs in our pieces, while game concurrency could seem a caos, we only allow players to play every 5 minutes to put a piece.
To avoid sybil attacks, players have to pay for each piece with an ERC-20 and sent into a set of contracts that manages the game logic and vaults. 
We implemented an anti-bot protection mechanism to only allow humans to play (because we hate bots and ¿AI?) and we have linked this unique idenity with dynamic social login. By doing a first set up, you have a unique account linked with your Google email, which will be used to sign messages and make moves.
For the payment logic, we have implemented part of the Coinbase commerce onchain payment protocol, to only allow players that are on our match to deposit money, and also winners to withdraw, we are admins so we are operators and we potentially make this game compliant as well.
TheGraph we use it for statistics, on the backend we use it to get the events happening on the latests moves of the game.
